show.description: Forced into marriage with a "garbage collector" by her abusive family, Netra Rawat discovers her husband is actually a billionaire tycoon who empowers her to become a powerful CEO. Together, they dismantle her family’s cruel schemes and corporate fraud, proving her worth as the queen of a global empire.
